summary: More optional build_report sheets: usage_by_organizations for chargeback, usage_by_collections, usage_by_roles, usage_by_modules, managed_nodes_by_organization and data_collection_status (gaps between collections), all enabled with METRICS_UTILITY_OPTIONAL_CCSP_REPORT_SHEETS.
questions: How do I enable all optional sheets in metrics-utility?
How do I do chargeback by organization in AAP?

answer_card.title: Enable all optional report sheets
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
export METRICS_UTILITY_OPTIONAL_CCSP_REPORT_SHEETS='ccsp_summary,jobs,managed_nodes,indirectly_managed_nodes,inventory_scope,usage_by_organizations,usage_by_collections,usage_by_roles,usage_by_modules,data_collection_status'
```

`usage_by_organizations` is suited to internal chargeback; `data_collection_status` shows gaps in the data `gather` collected.
